component.name: LLM Quota Tray
component.summary: Provider-agnostic tray indicator for LLM API quota

description.p: A status-notifier tray icon that polls an LLM-provider quota API on a configurable cadence and shows the current remaining quota as a chip and a per-window breakdown in its menu. The shipped example targets the MiniMax API (Coding Plan + Token Plan); every provider-specific field (endpoint, JSON shape, auth style, ring colors, label) lives in a per-instance JSON config, so the binary itself is fully generic.

Multiple concurrent instances are supported via --instance=<name> (different config dirs, lock files, keyring namespaces, and tray chips). Click the chip to see per-window reset countdowns, the burn-rate projection, and the action menu (Refresh / Open dashboard / Set API Key… / Quit).
